messages:
maria: Heads up — holding today's release window. Staging canary is failing due to a remote cache lockup on the ci-artifacts job, causing promote to hang. digging.

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary promotion paused automatically (reason: cache_lease_timeout) — promotion id 0x7f3a queued.

sam: quick log snippet — seeing lease conflicts + PUT timeouts:
```
ci-artifacts: ERROR failed to acquire cache lease: LeaseTimeout
PUT /cache/123/lease -> 409 Conflict
Restore attempt failed after retries
```

jake: Can we pin the last-good artifact and manually promote that while we investigate? tag is `release-2026-03-19-rc2`. command I used before: `./deploybot promote --tag release-2026-03-19-rc2 --force`

maria: +1 to pin. Idea: promote pinned image to staging and run a quick prod-smoke-only rollout (skip full e2e) to keep the change window.

sam: I'll try to clear stuck leases first. Running the unlock helper now, then artifact-verify.
```
./scripts/cache_unlock.sh --bucket ci-cache --key 12345 --force
# output: unlocked 1 leases, remaining: 0
```

deploy-bot: deploybot: manual promote requested by @sam — awaiting artifact-verify hook / checks.

kevin-pd: if we miss the change window in EU we push a bunch of customers to the next day. Is a smaller hotfix-only promote acceptable?

jake: @kevin-pd we can carve out noncritical features and only include bugfix/security commits in the promoted RC. That reduces blast radius.

sre-oncall: I'll increase restore timeout for cache restores from 10s -> 30s in the CI config to reduce immediate flakiness while we stabilize. Will monitor the canary once unlock + verify are done.

maria: Plan: 1) @sam runs unlock + artifact-verify (ETA ~10m). 2) @jake prepares pinned promote and a minimal release notes diff. 3) If artifact-verify passes, deploy-bot will promote `release-2026-03-19-rc2` to staging and we run prod-smoke only. 4) If unlock fails, we roll back to the currently promoted image and escalate. @kevin-pd ok?

kevin-pd: :thumbsup: please also include the commit sha in notes — `abcdef12` for tracking.

deploy-bot: deploybot: promotion completed: `release-2026-03-19-rc2` promoted to staging by @sam at 3795436821. status: queued smoke, wait for SRE clearance.

maria: Great — monitoring. Will post a follow-up once smoke clears or if we need to open a rollback ticket.
